## Problem

What user problem does this change solve?

## Behavior

What changed, and what did you deliberately leave out?

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] I tested the unpacked extension in a Chromium browser.
- [ ] I tested keyboard focus and a narrow viewport for UI changes.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I included before/after screenshots for visual changes.
- [ ] I did not add telemetry, affiliate tracking or remote scripts.
- [ ] I documented any new browser permission or network behavior.

## Evidence

Screenshots, anonymized fixtures, test output or other useful context.
